hyps.why: Edge 4 is dead when edge 0 is none, so removing it costs nothing.
Edge 5 is mostly dead when edge 1 is none, so removing it costs little.
Without the direct edge, edge 4 is a key path to the output.
Without the direct edge, edge 5 is a key path to the output.
Edge 4 is dead without edge 0, so a conv there gives little gain.
With no direct input-output edge, a conv on edge 5 matters more.
A conv already on edge 5 reduces the marginal benefit of another conv into the output.
Another conv into the output node adds less when edge 4 already has one.
Adding any op where the edge was absent adds a path, unlike swapping among existing ops.
Removing a useful skip on the direct edge hurts more than removing weaker ops or an absent edge.
